output.title: Elegant 4-Bedroom Semi-Detached Family Home with South-Facing Garden
output.description:
Nestled in a tranquil and established Luxembourg neighborhood, this charming semi-detached residence from the 1990s presents an exquisite opportunity for discerning families seeking comfort and timeless appeal. Spanning 195 m² of well-appointed living space, the property boasts four spacious bedrooms and two full bathrooms, harmoniously designed to meet both everyday needs and refined tastes.

The inviting living room serves as the heart of the home, featuring a graceful open-plan layout that seamlessly connects to the dining area. Rich tile flooring underfoot and a classic fireplace enhance the warm ambiance, while double doors open directly onto the private, south-facing rear garden, inviting abundant natural light and outdoor enjoyment.

Culinary enthusiasts will appreciate the traditional kitchen, outfitted with elegant wood cabinetry, a classic tile splashback, and a freestanding range. A cozy breakfast nook offers a perfect spot for casual family meals, combining both function and comfort within a family-style setting.

Outdoors, the tranquil garden provides a peaceful retreat with its well-kept lawn and private patio, enjoying coveted southern exposure. Additional conveniences include a private driveway and practical storage areas, completing this exceptional offering where charm, functionality, and quality craftsmanship unite.

highlights.text: Spacious 195 m² semi-detached house with four bedrooms
Sunny south-facing private rear garden and patio
Open-plan living and dining area with fireplace
Traditional kitchen featuring wood cabinetry and breakfast nook
Tile flooring throughout main living spaces
Private driveway providing convenient off-street parking
